answer: A Sybil defense can require each agent identity to lock a refundable bond before earning reputation. Random audits slash the bond when identities share hidden control; honest agents recover it after a fixed period. Creating many accounts therefore ties up capital and risks losing each stake. A whisper network cannot cheaply evade this: a beacon audit selects identities unpredictably, while the fable of free accounts ends when every identity must fund its own bond.
